What to look for

Check the hands as they swing past her clothes and bag, especially in Left and the diagonal views. On the alley trip, watch her pass behind the bright pole: her head should stay whole until the pole actually hides it. Try a close-up and half speed if a turn looks odd.

This is a movement test with eight facing directions. Routes and foot placement use a ground plane; the painted views blend during turns. The view blends and newly prepared artwork still need visual review. Bag position is kept with the character, including when the body or buildings obscure it.
